source_records.title: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot
source_records.summary_text: GitHub's August 6 changelog establishes Kimi K3 availability in Copilot, with gradual rollout across named plans and surfaces, a documented pause/resumption note, and administrator policy requirements for Business and Enterprise.

metadata.rollout: gradual; resumed after temporary pause noted by GitHub
metadata.claim_boundary: GitHub Copilot availability, hosting, billing, and policy only
